title: Good quality bags but they don’t work
text:
Good quality bags but they don’t work. I bought these bags for two reasons.
One was for defrosting baked goods I purchase from Whole Foods & etc.
My plan was to place the frozen item to be defrosted in the cloth bag then hang it up so air could circulate around the bag & the item would defrost evenly.
The second was to store the defrosted baked goods in the plastic perforated bag along with the cloth bag.
The put a loaf of raisin challah in and after the first day I noticed the bread was a lot drier.
And by day two, it was as if the bread was sitting out for a week.
I have he never had bread dry out so quickly.
I was very disappointed as I hoped this would eliminate dry stale bread & soggy muffin tops.
The bags are good quality and I’ll continue to use them to defrost my baked goods.
But using the plastic & cloth bag to store my baked goods is not an option
